sourceFindings.finding: WRC537 states that the precision equations were prepared to eliminate implementation errors, facilitate proper interpolation and extrapolation, and permit efficient computation. It does not state the interpolation variable/transform or algorithm between tabulated shell-parameter gamma curves.

The cylindrical nondimensional curves are described as replots of Bijlaard data to semilog scale so portions can be read more easily; this does not define interpolation between discrete gamma coefficient curves.
Appendix A discusses empirical extrapolation behavior and cases that can be unconservative; it does not authorize a gamma interpolation algorithm.

independentBenchmarkProbe.conclusion: The qualified CAUx 1979 chart-read benchmark does not uniquely identify a WRC537 gamma interpolation algorithm.

prohibitedUntilAuthorityExists: linear interpolation of evaluated Y in gamma
linear interpolation of evaluated Y in log(gamma)
linear interpolation of evaluated Y in inverse gamma
allowedWithoutInterpolationAuthority: evaluate a source-qualified curve when the requested gamma exactly matches a source-qualified gamma row
use source-reported benchmark ordinates for an independently qualified external benchmark without claiming they define WRC537 interpolation
requiredToClose: A direct authoritative interpolation rule, erratum, implementation note, or source-qualified WRC537 numerical example that uniquely identifies the gamma-selection/interpolation algorithm.
